punchline: A mapmaker taught money lessons from the bank counter.
thirty_sec: George Clason founded a map company in Denver that did not survive the Great Depression. The Babylon parables he wrote on thrift were handed out by banks and insurance companies, and collected as a book in 1926.
question: Which single sentence would you use to hand someone a money habit?
key_contrast: A short story and one-line rule instead of a long financial plan.
